ai_summary: AB Cotspin India Limited's board approved the routine re-appointment of M/s Jain Sharma & Associate as cost auditor for FY 2026-27. More significantly, the company plans to change its name to 'ABC Industries India Limited,' pending shareholder approval, which may signal a strategic shift or broadening of its business scope beyond its current 'Cotspin' identity. The absence of a stated rationale for this material re-branding could prompt investors to seek further clarity on the company's evolving strategy and future direction.
